root_cause.text: Multiple Ceph filesystem functions pass an uninitialized `struct ceph_path_info` stack variable to `ceph_mdsc_build_path()`, which results in `ceph_mdsc_free_path_info()` attempting to free uninitialized pointers if the path building fails.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states that `ceph_mdsc_build_path()` only initializes the `ceph_path_info` structure on success, and the patch diff shows the addition of zero-initializers (`= {0}`) to `struct ceph_path_info path_info` in `fs/ceph/debugfs.c`, `fs/ceph/dir.c`, `fs/ceph/file.c`, and `fs/ceph/inode.c` to prevent crashes in `ceph_mdsc_free_path_info()`.
